destinations.name: Spiti Valley
destinations.description: A cold desert mountain valley high in the Himalayas, Spiti is one of India's least populated and most pristine regions. Ancient Buddhist monasteries cling to cliffsides, and the stark, dramatic landscapes feel like another planet.

outdoor_activities.name: Key Monastery Visit
outdoor_activities.description: Visit the 1000-year-old Key Monastery perched at 4,166m

outdoor_activities.name: Chandratal Lake Trek
outdoor_activities.description: Trek to the crescent-shaped Moon Lake at 4,300m

outdoor_activities.name: Hikkim Post Office Visit
outdoor_activities.description: Send a postcard from the world's highest post office

outdoor_activities.name: Pin Valley National Park
outdoor_activities.description: Spot the elusive snow leopard and ibex in this cold desert park

outdoor_activities.name: Dhankar Monastery & Lake
outdoor_activities.description: Explore the precarious cliffside monastery and hike to Dhankar Lake

outdoor_activities.name: Langza Fossil Hunting
outdoor_activities.description: Hunt for marine fossils in the village of Langza at 4,400m — yes, sea fossils in the mountains

outdoor_activities.name: Kibber-Chicham Bridge Walk
outdoor_activities.description: Walk across Asia's highest bridge connecting Kibber and Chicham

outdoor_activities.name: Spiti River Rafting
outdoor_activities.description: White water rafting in the glacial Spiti River

indoor_activities.name: Buddhist Meditation Session
indoor_activities.description: Join monks for a guided meditation at Key Monastery

indoor_activities.name: Spitian Cooking Class
indoor_activities.description: Learn to make thukpa, momos, and butter tea with a local family

indoor_activities.name: Yak Wool Weaving Workshop
indoor_activities.description: Learn traditional yak wool weaving from local artisans

indoor_activities.name: Local Café & Chhang Tasting
indoor_activities.description: Try the local barley beer (chhang) and Spitian snacks at a Kaza café

destinations.name: Coorg
destinations.description: Known as the 'Scotland of India', Coorg (Kodagu) is a lush hill district famous for coffee plantations, misty hills, spice gardens, and the martial Kodava culture. A paradise for nature lovers and food enthusiasts.

outdoor_activities.name: Abbey Falls Visit
outdoor_activities.description: Walk through coffee plantations to reach this stunning waterfall

outdoor_activities.name: Tadiandamol Peak Trek
outdoor_activities.description: Trek to the highest peak in Coorg at 1,748m through shola forests

outdoor_activities.name: Dubare Elephant Camp
outdoor_activities.description: Interact with elephants — bathe and feed them at the Cauvery riverside camp

outdoor_activities.name: Coffee Plantation Walk
outdoor_activities.description: Guided tour of a working coffee estate — from bean to cup

outdoor_activities.name: Raja's Seat Sunset
outdoor_activities.description: Watch a spectacular sunset from this hilltop garden where Kodava kings once sat

outdoor_activities.name: Nagarhole Safari
outdoor_activities.description: Jeep safari in Nagarhole National Park — spot tigers, elephants, and bison

outdoor_activities.name: Cauvery River Rafting
outdoor_activities.description: White water rafting on the River Cauvery

outdoor_activities.name: Iruppu Falls Trek
outdoor_activities.description: Trek through the Brahmagiri forest to sacred Iruppu Falls

indoor_activities.name: Kodava Cooking Class
indoor_activities.description: Learn to make authentic pandi curry, akki roti, and Coorg-style biryani

indoor_activities.name: Coffee Roasting Workshop
indoor_activities.description: Hands-on workshop on roasting, grinding, and brewing estate coffee

indoor_activities.name: Spice Garden Tour
indoor_activities.description: Walk through a spice garden — identify pepper, cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves

indoor_activities.name: Madikeri Fort & Museum
indoor_activities.description: Explore the historic Madikeri Fort built by Muddu Raja and its museum

indoor_activities.name: Bylakuppe Tibetan Settlement
indoor_activities.description: Visit the Golden Temple and Tibetan monasteries in India's second-largest Tibetan settlement

destinations.name: Meghalaya
destinations.description: The 'Abode of Clouds' is one of India's wettest and most magical states. Known for living root bridges, crystal-clear rivers, dramatic waterfalls, and the unique matrilineal Khasi culture. Truly one of India's hidden gems.

outdoor_activities.name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge Trek
outdoor_activities.description: Trek 3,500 steps down to see the iconic double-decker living root bridge in Nongriat

outdoor_activities.name: Dawki River Boating
outdoor_activities.description: Boat on the crystal-clear Umngot River — boats appear to float in mid-air

outdoor_activities.name: Mawlynnong Village Walk
outdoor_activities.description: Explore Asia's cleanest village and its sky walk viewpoint

outdoor_activities.name: Nohkalikai Falls Viewpoint
outdoor_activities.description: India's tallest plunge waterfall at 340m, with a stunning turquoise pool

outdoor_activities.name: Mawsmai Cave Exploration
outdoor_activities.description: Explore limestone caves with stunning stalactite and stalagmite formations

outdoor_activities.name: David Scott Trail Trek
outdoor_activities.description: Trek the historic 16km trail through rolling hills, forests, and streams

outdoor_activities.name: Laitlum Canyons
outdoor_activities.description: Walk along the edge of dramatic canyons — 'laitlum' means 'end of hills' in Khasi

outdoor_activities.name: Umiam Lake Kayaking
outdoor_activities.description: Kayak on the serene Umiam Lake surrounded by East Khasi Hills

indoor_activities.name: Khasi Cooking Class
indoor_activities.description: Learn to make jadoh, tungrymbai, and doh khleh with a Khasi family

indoor_activities.name: Don Bosco Museum
indoor_activities.description: Explore 7 floors showcasing Northeast India's indigenous cultures

indoor_activities.name: Bamboo & Cane Craft Workshop
indoor_activities.description: Learn traditional Khasi bamboo and cane weaving techniques

indoor_activities.name: Shillong Music Scene
indoor_activities.description: Experience why Shillong is called 'Rock Capital of India' at a local live music café

indoor_activities.name: Iewduh (Bara Bazaar) Food Tour
indoor_activities.description: Guided food tour of the largest market in Northeast India

destinations.name: Rishikesh
destinations.description: Nestled in the Himalayan foothills along the holy Ganges, Rishikesh is the yoga capital of the world, combining spiritual ashrams, cliffside meditation, and high-adrenaline river rafting.

outdoor_activities.name: Neer Garh Waterfall Hike

outdoor_activities.name: Beatles Ashram Exploration
outdoor_activities.description: Abandoned ashram with colorful spiritual murals overlooking the Ganges

outdoor_activities.name: Laxman Jhula & Suspension Bridges

outdoor_activities.name: Triveni Ghat Evening Ganga Aarti
outdoor_activities.description: Sacred twilight prayer ceremony with floating oil lamps

outdoor_activities.name: Shivpuri River Rafting

indoor_activities.name: Ganga View Ashram Yoga & Meditation

indoor_activities.name: Ayurvedic Herbal Cooking Workshop

indoor_activities.name: Traditional Kullu Shawl Weaving

destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.description: God's Own Country, famed for tranquil emerald backwaters, spice-scented hill stations, tea plantations, and secluded coastal palm beaches.

outdoor_activities.name: Edakkal Caves Petroglyph Hike
outdoor_activities.description: Climb Ambukuthi Hills to inspect prehistoric cave carvings

outdoor_activities.name: Alleppey Backwater Canoe Tour
outdoor_activities.description: Glide through narrow village canals on an eco-friendly wooden canoe
